column1: # Curated RepBase family -> (repFamily, repClass) for the hg38 reference index.
# Provenance: columns 1, 4 and 5 of the RepBase block (lines 5277-6500) of
# Same derivation style as refdata/repbase18.05-classes.txt and -drop-exact.txt.
# WHY IT EXISTS (-475.42): 354 of these 1,224 families have no genomic instances in the
# modern UCSC rmsk track, so no repClass/repFamily is available for them and column 4 --
# the label reads are counted under -- would otherwise fall back to the family's own name,
# splitting e.g. alpha-satellite variants out of centr instead of pooling them.
# CIRCULAR: derived from the reference, so it must be EXCLUDED when measuring how well an
# autogenerated hg38 filelist reproduces that reference (-475.22). It is consulted only
# AFTER the rmsk table, so current RepeatMasker calls always win and post-2020
# reclassification stays visible rather than being frozen.
# Mouse uses this file too: 170 mouse RepBase families share an exact family name with a
# human one, and 167 of 168 shared names carry the identical RepBase class token in both
# species, so a shared name is the same consensus family.
